blocks.text: A new hire must complete Section 1 of Form I-9 on or before their first day of employment. HR must complete Section 2, verifying the employee's identity and employment authorization documents, within 3 business days of the employee's first day.

If the employee presents a receipt for a lost, stolen, or damaged document, HR may temporarily accept the receipt. The employee must provide the original document within 90 days of the first day of employment.

For remote employees who cannot appear in person, an authorized representative may complete Section 2 on behalf of the employer. HR must record the authorized representative's full name and contact information in the employer notes.

If an employee cannot provide acceptable documentation by the end of 3 business days, HR must notify Legal before allowing the employee to continue working. Legal determines the appropriate next steps.
